subject: Pilot access maintenance request - voucher while contract clears
messages:
From: Simon Carter <simon.carter@atlashealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot access for AtlasHealth — procurement update

Hi Kimberly,

Quick update — legal has signed off on the SOW but procurement says the PO won't be issued until early next week due to an internal approval cycle. The engineering team is mid-run of the pilot (model comparisons and latency benchmarks) and we're concerned about losing continuity.

Would Redwood be able to provide a short, one-week voucher or temporary sandbox credits so our engineers can finish the evaluation without interruption? We'll attach the draft PO for context.

Attachments: Atlas_PO_DRAFT.pdf (pdf)

Thanks — appreciate any flexibility.

Simon
Simon Carter
Director of Platform Engineering, AtlasHealth
scarter@atlashealth.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot access for AtlasHealth — procurement update

Hi Simon — thanks for the heads up and for sending the PO draft.

We can absolutely keep the pilot live while the PO clears. I can provision a temporary sandbox voucher to preserve the current workspace and token quota for one week. If procurement needs a little longer we can discuss a short extension.

Couple quick asks so I can fast-track this with ops:
- Can you confirm the expected PO issuance date from procurement?
- Will Atlas need any additional seats or environment changes during the extra week?

I will loop in Marissa on credits approval so we can get you the voucher today.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly@redwoodinference.com
